_comment: Professions (guilds) and their gathering stations (GDD 5.4, systems.md 5.1-5.2). This file is the one source of truth for a guild: the server, the realtime rooms and the client all read it. guild: how the guild shows up (kit = the art files client/src/world/kits/<kit>.ts and client/src/ui/portraits/<kit>.tsx; hall and piazza = the guild's hall and square names, and quarter = a short label (the guild quarters that used them were removed in 0.13.0; kept for when guilds get their own places again); goods = the Mercato heading; workbench = the 3D workbench label; color and trim = quarter banners; hats = hat names, in the order the server stores them, one per hat in the kit). station.find_label: the rich-find surprise text (#48). Rates are units per hour and caps are the most a station holds; both are scaled by economy.pace.time_multiplier. unlock_skill (default 1): the skill at which a new player starts gathering that raw; players who already gathered it before 0.8.0 keep it. workshop (0.11.0, #51): the bottega upgrades that open each rank (level 2 opens Journeyman, 3 Expert, 4 Master); each costs ducats plus goods from both other guilds (only goods crafters one rank lower can make) and takes hours to build (x the pace); what a level gives is in economy.json workshop.

professions.trainer: Mastro Ferrante, forge master of the Arsenale
professions.name: Blacksmith
professions.description: Mine copper and iron, forge brass fittings every crafter needs, and make lanterns and swords for the Regatta crowd.
professions.needs_from_others: Smelting Flux (Alchemist) and Leather Grips (Leatherworker) for the iron tier.

minigame.title: Work the seam
minigame.intro: Swing when the pick is over the glint. Clean strikes break off the most ore.

professions.trainer: Dottoressa Livia, keeper of the guild still
professions.name: Alchemist
professions.description: Grow sunleaf and ember moss, brew the harbor's healing draughts, and supply the fluxes and solutions other guilds rely on.

minigame.title: Harvest by hand
minigame.intro: Cut when the sickle is over the ripest stems. Clean cuts bring in the most.

professions.trainer: Zio Tobia, the old master tanner
professions.name: Leatherworker
professions.description: Send trappers out for hides, stitch grips and satchels, and craft armour for sailors and ships' guards.
professions.needs_from_others: Tanning Solution (Alchemist) and Brass Fittings (Blacksmith) for the higher tier.

minigame.title: Set the snares
minigame.intro: Spring the snare when the hare crosses the trail. Clean catches bring in the most.
